I am honestly amazed how much flavor was shoved into this game. Somehow this game almost feels like you are playing Digital Circus as a game. The depth of this game continues to baffle me as I progress further into the runs and story. Very cute, addictive, and absolutely fantastic art. This game deserves way more attention than it is getting so far. EDIT: Honestly incredible how much they shoved in this game, tons of passion in the work shown. The Inscryption meets WarioWare of clicker games. However, I do think the voice acting in cut scenes detracts from the experience as they are not particularly good voices in my opinion. I think all the voice acted cut scenes could instead continue with the Deltrarune/Undertale type machine voices they use in other areas of this game. I love the voices during gameplay though! This game is very near, dear, and close to my heart. It is so silly, but also gets heartwarming near the end. And whenever you think this game is done with it's absurdity, it always finds a way to ramp it up further. I never expected this game to have as much of an emotional resonance for me as it did, and yet I shall always keep this game close to my heart.
